svg.title: Corsa-e CAN networks - consolidated engineering map
svg.desc: Editable vector redraw. Solid external wiring is sourced; VCU internal continuity is reported without a measurement record; possible BSI and ESP internal connections are dashed and unverified.
svg.text: Consolidated vector schematic | English wire colours | P2JO / P2J0 wiring collection | revision 3 / 2026-11-11
Source-derived wiring; vehicle fitment not yet verified
Details A-F below. Repeated unit IDs refer to the same ECU. Each coloured network line represents a CAN conductor pair.
Driver-side lower dashboard / interior fuse assembly
BCM6 = roof SOS console, not 84C4. No CAN pair is drawn through its IC95A connection. [T]
D: HS CAN2 | E: passenger-compartment CAN | F: ADAS
C: VCU eCAN feeds motor / battery / OBC. F: local headlamp CAN behind 6606.
VCU internal continuity is reported without a measurement record; BSI/ESP ties remain hypotheses.
A HS CAN1 / telematics + OBD + vehicle
Separate BSI ports and ESP ports are deliberately not shorted together.
E934 / E935 share the dashboard pair; the second BSI run is separate.
Supply: +BAT_CSP classification; continuous KL30 availability has not been measured.
Ground: 84C4 / 18-way Black / pin 16, MD84C Green/Yellow -> EM50B -> body earth MC50B.
The grey reference line above links only supply pins via EZ55; ground is a separate circuit.
C eCAN / VCU + traction system + OBC
The two eCAN runs are reported to join inside 1775 in the installation notes [U01].
The source sheet alone does not depict this internal continuity. No VCU cross-bus forwarding
or electrical join to HS CAN1 / HS CAN2 is implied.
93P5B / 93P6B at 1708 and 1778 are distinct external wire runs; identical labels
must not be used to bypass the VCU branch routing.
Baseline shown: D3CZV77G. Other equipment layouts are listed separately.
Alternative D3CZV78G: radar 7571 on main bus via ICY4 / 5,2; radar 6-way Black / 5,4.
Radar-local 9A37 = Green; 9A38 = Red. Incoming 9A37C = Pink; 9A38C = Beige.
Alternative D3CZV76G: BSI 35-way Black 8,22 (9091 Pink) / 6,20 (9092 Blue) loop.
Camera 35-way Black / 6,8 assignments differ in ADAS layout F. Do not combine variants.
Two external BSI branches; no internal continuity is asserted.
Equipment alternatives. Camera pins overlap with layout D but wire families differ.
ICY4 = 10-way Green. RB / BB colour codes are preserved as unresolved, not guessed.
6606 HS CAN1 port is in A.
Solid network line: one CAN pair. Both conductors are listed at each endpoint. Dots: simplified shared splices.
Solid green inside VCU [U01]: reported internal eCAN tie. Dashed amber + ?: unverified internal tie.
Card rows = cavity : printed wire ID | English physical wire colour. Network stroke colours are only visual grouping.
H/L polarity and bitrate are not assigned. Connector cavity viewing direction is not established.
NR Black | BE Blue | BA White | GR Grey | VE Green
MR Brown | RS Pink | VI Violet | BG Beige | RG Red
OR Orange | JN Yellow | VJ Green/Yellow | ND Unspecified
RB / BB: unresolved. Slash colours retain both components.
Source keys A-F / T / L / Q are resolved in the adjacent README and JSON.
OBD [Q]: D3CZV7FG. Power: T + BSI fuse allocation [P]. U01: installation notes, 2026-10-28.
Not a full harness: LIN, diesel DEPOLLUTION and trailer options omitted.
Variants are not a single verified vehicle configuration. No CAN commands implied.
